I have farmed for many years without school learning, so I follow the old ways my father taught me. This plot is rented, not my own land, so I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer or improved seed that I cannot afford when the owner will take a share. My family and our oxen will do all the work, using manure from our animals to keep the soil good, and I will not hire outsiders since we can manage the labor ourselves with God's help.
